::: {.about-content}

::: {.about-intro}
Hello! I'm originally from **Dhaka**, the vibrant capital city of Bangladesh. I came to the US in 2015 in pursuit of my bachelor's degree in Computer Science and lived in West Michigan before moving to Northern Virginia in 2022. 

I am currently a **Data Analyst II** at Shift Digital in the Data Operations and Analytics team, where I leverage data-driven solutions for enterprise clients. I graduated with a **Master's of Science in Data Science & Analytics** from Georgetown University in 2025. My passion lies in leveraging tailored data and algorithms to solve intricate business problems and communicating complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.

I love spending time in charming cafes and exploring new cuisines. During my downtime I enjoy reading, painting and watching movies/TV shows.
:::

## 📊 Professional Journey

::: {.journey-visual}
<div id="journey-timeline"></div>

<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<script>
// Journey data
const journeyData = [
  {
    year: "2015-2020",
    title: "Bachelor of Science",
    organization: "Grand Valley State University",
    location: "Grand Rapids, MI",
    description: "Computer Science",
    type: "education",
    startYear: 2015,
    endYear: 2020
  },
  {
    year: "2020-2021",
    title: "Computer Engineer",
    organization: "Array of Engineers",
    location: "Grand Rapids, MI",
    description: "Avionics software verification and web development",
    type: "work",
    startYear: 2020,
    endYear: 2021
  },
  {
    year: "2021-2023",
    title: "Data Analyst I",
    organization: "Shift Digital",
    location: "Birmingham, MI",
    description: "Data operations and analytics",
    type: "work",
    startYear: 2021,
    endYear: 2023
  },
  {
    year: "2023-2025",
    title: "Master's in Data Science",
    organization: "Georgetown University",
    location: "Washington, DC",
    description: "Data Science and Analytics",
    type: "education",
    startYear: 2023,
    endYear: 2025
  },
  {
    year: "2025-present",
    title: "Data Analyst II",
    organization: "Shift Digital",
    location: "Birmingham, MI",
    description: "Leading data operations and analytics initiatives",
    type: "work",
    startYear: 2025,
    endYear: 2026
  }
];

// Set up dimensions and margins
const margin = {top: 60, right: 60, bottom: 80, left: 60};
const width = Math.min(1200, window.innerWidth - 40) - margin.left - margin.right;
const height = 500 - margin.top - margin.bottom;

// Create SVG
const svg = d3.select("#journey-timeline")
  .append("svg")
  .attr("width", width + margin.left + margin.right)
  .attr("height", height + margin.top + margin.bottom)
  .style("background", "linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)")
  .style("border-radius", "15px")
  .style("box-shadow", "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)");

const g = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

// Create scales
const xScale = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([2015, 2026])
  .range([0, width]);

// Create timeline line
g.append("line")
  .attr("x1", 0)
  .attr("x2", width)
  .attr("y1", height / 2)
  .attr("y2", height / 2)
  .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)")
  .attr("stroke-width", 3);

// Create year markers
const yearMarkers = [2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2025];
g.selectAll(".year-marker")
  .data(yearMarkers)
  .enter()
  .append("text")
  .attr("class", "year-marker")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d))
  .attr("y", height - 10)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("fill", "white")
  .style("font-size", "14px")
  .style("font-weight", "600")
  .text(d => d);

// Create journey items with alternating positions
const journeyItems = g.selectAll(".journey-item")
  .data(journeyData)
  .enter()
  .append("g")
  .attr("class", "journey-item");

// Add timeline bars with alternating positions
journeyItems.append("rect")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d.startYear))
  .attr("y", (d, i) => i % 2 === 0 ? height/2 - 25 : height/2 + 5)
  .attr("width", d => xScale(d.endYear) - xScale(d.startYear))
  .attr("height", 20)
  .attr("rx", 10)
  .style("fill", d => d.type === "education" ? "#4facfe" : "#43e97b")
  .style("opacity", 0.9)
  .style("cursor", "pointer")
  .on("mouseover", function(event, d) {
    d3.select(this).style("opacity", 1).style("transform", "scale(1.05)");
    
    // Show tooltip
    const tooltip = d3.select("body").append("div")
      .attr("class", "journey-tooltip")
      .style("position", "absolute")
      .style("background", "rgba(0,0,0,0.9)")
      .style("color", "white")
      .style("padding", "12px")
      .style("border-radius", "8px")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .style("box-shadow", "0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)")
      .style("z-index", "1000")
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .style("max-width", "250px");
    
    tooltip.html(`
      <strong>${d.title}</strong><br/>
      ${d.organization}<br/>
      <em>${d.location}</em><br/>
      <small>${d.description}</small>
    `)
    .style("left", (event.pageX + 10) + "px")
    .style("top", (event.pageY - 10) + "px")
    .transition()
    .duration(200)
    .style("opacity", 1);
  })
  .on("mouseout", function(event, d) {
    d3.select(this).style("opacity", 0.9).style("transform", "scale(1)");
    d3.selectAll(".journey-tooltip").remove();
  });

// Add connecting lines from timeline to bars
journeyItems.append("line")
  .attr("x1", d => xScale(d.startYear) + (xScale(d.endYear) - xScale(d.startYear)) / 2)
  .attr("y1", height / 2)
  .attr("x2", d => xScale(d.startYear) + (xScale(d.endYear) - xScale(d.startYear)) / 2)
  .attr("y2", (d, i) => i % 2 === 0 ? height/2 - 25 : height/2 + 25)
  .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)")
  .attr("stroke-width", 2);

// Add title text with alternating positions
journeyItems.append("text")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d.startYear) + (xScale(d.endYear) - xScale(d.startYear)) / 2)
  .attr("y", (d, i) => i % 2 === 0 ? height/2 - 35 : height/2 + 45)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("fill", "white")
  .style("font-size", "14px")
  .style("font-weight", "700")
  .text(d => d.title);

// Add organization text
journeyItems.append("text")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d.startYear) + (xScale(d.endYear) - xScale(d.startYear)) / 2)
  .attr("y", (d, i) => i % 2 === 0 ? height/2 - 50 : height/2 + 60)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("fill", "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)")
  .style("font-size", "12px")
  .style("font-weight", "500")
  .text(d => d.organization);

// Add year labels on bars
journeyItems.append("text")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d.startYear) + (xScale(d.endYear) - xScale(d.startYear)) / 2)
  .attr("y", (d, i) => i % 2 === 0 ? height/2 - 11 : height/2 + 19)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("fill", "white")
  .style("font-size", "11px")
  .style("font-weight", "600")
  .text(d => d.year);

// Add legend
const legend = g.append("g")
  .attr("class", "legend")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${width - 180}, 20)`);

legend.append("rect")
  .attr("x", 0)
  .attr("y", 0)
  .attr("width", 15)
  .attr("height", 15)
  .attr("rx", 7)
  .style("fill", "#4facfe");

legend.append("text")
  .attr("x", 25)
  .attr("y", 12)
  .style("fill", "white")
  .style("font-size", "14px")
  .style("font-weight", "500")
  .text("Education");

legend.append("rect")
  .attr("x", 0)
  .attr("y", 25)
  .attr("width", 15)
  .attr("height", 15)
  .attr("rx", 7)
  .style("fill", "#43e97b");

legend.append("text")
  .attr("x", 25)
  .attr("y", 37)
  .style("fill", "white")
  .style("font-size", "14px")
  .style("font-weight", "500")
  .text("Professional");

// Add animation
journeyItems.selectAll("rect")
  .style("transform", "scaleX(0)")
  .style("transform-origin", "left center")
  .transition()
  .duration(1000)
  .delay((d, i) => i * 200)
  .style("transform", "scaleX(1)");

journeyItems.selectAll("text")
  .style("opacity", 0)
  .transition()
  .duration(500)
  .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)
  .style("opacity", 1);
</script>
:::
